summary: You can use tridents enchanted with Riptide while riding entities
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft and enter a world where commands can be used.
2. Set the weather to rain with `/weather rain`.
3. Give yourself a Riptide III trident with `/give @s minecraft:trident[minecraft:enchantments={"minecraft:riptide":3}]`.
4. Mount any entity.
5. Attempt to throw the Riptide-enchanted trident while riding the entity.
6. Observe that the trident can be used while riding the entity and may damage the entity being ridden.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.16.5, 21w14a, 21w15a, 21w16a, 21w17a, 21w18a, 21w19a, 21w20a, 1.17 Pre-release 4, 1.17 Pre-release 5, 1.17 Release Candidate 1, 1.17, 1.17.1 Pre-release 1, 1.17.1 Pre-release 2, 1.17.1 Pre-release 3, 1.17.1 Release Candidate 1, 1.17.1, 21w37a, 1.18.1, 22w05a, 22w06a, 1.18.2, 1.19, 1.19.1, 1.19.2, 22w43a, 1.19.3, 1.19.4, 1.20.1, 24w20a, 1.21, 1.21.3, 1.21.4, 1.21.7, 25w41a, 1.21.11 (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior: While the player is riding another entity, a Riptide-enchanted trident can still be activated when the player is in rain or water. The activation propels the player as normal instead of being rejected because the player is a passenger. Depending on the mounted entity and the resulting movement, the Riptide activation can also damage the entity the player is riding.
Expected Behavior: While the player is riding an entity, attempting to use a Riptide-enchanted trident should fail, even during rain or while in water. The trident should not be thrown or propel the player, and the ridden entity should not be damaged as a result. Riptide tridents should remain usable normally when the player is not riding another entity.
